verdict.rationale: Sketch's product page documents several embedded AI-powered actions (auto dark-mode conversion, palette generation from a photo, auto-sorting/renaming layers, replacing placeholder text, generating code from frames) that a user can invoke inside the app to offload specific tasks, which functions like a built-in AI assistant for design chores. However, this is a set of discrete point-features rather than a general conversational assistant you delegate open-ended tasks to, and the MCP server (docs-49) is framed as letting external AI clients act on Sketch rather than an assistant native to the UI. Missing for 10: evidence of a unified in-app assistant interface/chat for delegating arbitrary tasks, and independent/hands-on corroboration of these AI features' reliability.
